items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 2:1
items.html: There is no AA in the Klipot, only in the world of Yetzirah and Assiyah. For the Klipot were built from the ruin and deficiency of the holiness that was made in them by the sin of the First Man. Now, before the sin, ZON were already in the place of the AA and AVI of Atzilut, and BYA were in the place of YESHSUT and ZON of Atzilut. And because of the sin all these high Mochin that had come in the secret of the additional Mochin were corrupted, and nothing remained in them but the permanent Mochin of Atzilut. And ZON descended to VAK and a point, and BYA descended below the Parsa of Atzilut.
